LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDecree.label: Flower Decree
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDecree.comps.0.resourceDescr: Charge resource used to cast Flying Flower Decree abilities.
LanguageData.MX_QH_CombatState.label: Four-Season Resonance
LanguageData.MX_QH_CombatState.description: Hidden state: records Qinghe's current Four-Season Resonance.
LanguageData.MX_QH_SwordPressure.label: Sword Pressure
LanguageData.MX_QH_SwordPressure.comps.0.resourceDesc: Builds when Qinghe strikes enemies with her sword. Incomplete Sword Pressure gradually decays after she stops gaining it.
LanguageData.MX_QH_MeditativeStillness.label: Stillness
LanguageData.MX_QH_MeditativeStillness.description: A manifestation of Qinghe's focused creativity. Accumulates while meditating, reading or resting. When performing construction, crafting or art that has a quality level, current Stillness grants a quality bonus of up to +1. When Stillness is full, the next creation is guaranteed +2 quality levels and consumes all accumulated Stillness.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerResonance.label: Resonance
LanguageData.MX_QH_AscentSlashInvulnerable.label: damage immunity (Falling Blossoms)
LanguageData.MX_QH_AscentSlashInvulnerable.descriptio: Airborne and temporarily immune to all damage.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trickle.label: Trickle
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trickle.description: Qinghe slowly recovers from wounds over time, eventually restoring permanent injuries and missing body parts.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContract.label: Luoshen contract
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContract.description: Hidden state: records the Luoshen contract binding between Qinghe and her spouse.
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringFlow.label: spring flow blessing
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringFlow.description: Bathed in spring flow, gaining <color=#FF69B4>increased melee and ranged damage, reduced incoming damage, reduced pain, and immunity to Death Sentence accumulation</color>.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowingForm.label: Flowing Form
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowingForm.description:
When taking damage that could be lethal or destroy a body part, negate the hit, repair all injuries, and gain brief invulnerability and 10 seconds of psychic invisibility. Unavailable when charges are depleted.
—A form like flowing water, a spirit like a gentle breeze.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowingFormImmunity.label: Divine Response
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowingFormImmunity.description: Blessed by the Flower God, temporarily immune to all damage.
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraMastery.label: Aura Mastery
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraMastery.description:
A manifestation of Qinghe's mastery of cultivation. As her mastery level rises, her base abilities improve.
Completing crafting or artistic work with a quality level grants mastery experience based on the finished item's value and quality.
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShield.label: Aura Ward
LanguageData.MX_QH_AuraShield.description: Resonating with the breath of nature, Qinghe draws on her aura to form an impenetrable shield against all incoming damage. While active, it reduces stagger duration by 90%. Once broken, it takes 20 seconds to recharge, leaving her unprotected during that time.
